others.route: Autorisation d'embauchage et permis de travail

note: Monaco keeps no free movement of its own: an employer reports every job offer to the Employment Office, which first sends candidates with priority (Monegasques and their families, residents of Monaco, then residents of the neighbouring communes already employed there), and the hire is made on an authorisation to hire, after which the employee receives a work permit (Monaco Government, How to recruit staff). The page names no days of work without it.

sources.title: Gouvernement Princier de Monaco, Mon Entreprise: How to recruit staff
sources.said: Any job offer must be reported to the Employment Office who will then forward the suitable candidates who have priority status in terms of employment in Monaco. ... Once all administrative approvals have been obtained, the employee receives: A work permit
